_comment: FIXTURE. Shape copied from a real published waivers.json (benchmark-data ic/edge_llm_accel/waivers.json). Three entries: one correctly owned, and two that are not owned in two different ways. A gate that accepts any of the last two has no owner requirement.

waived_steps.reason: tapeout sign-off reached the evidence threshold but a DRC/LVS slot was credited via a waiver (verdict_tier=PASS_WITH_WAIVERS) - NOT a bare PASS. Production tapeout review must close the waived slot before mask order.
waived_steps._fixture_note: VERBATIM from the real published run. The approver key is PRESENT and names nobody: 'tapeout-review-pending' is a state, not a person or a role that can be asked. This is the harder of the two failures because a presence check passes it.

waived_steps.reason: Setup timing at the ss corner is short of the target by 0.08 ns. Waived for this release.
waived_steps._fixture_note: The approver key is ABSENT. Nobody accepted this risk; the waiver simply exists. This is the blunt form and any owner check catches it.

waived_steps.reason: Antenna ratio exceeded on two nets; the router's diode insertion is deferred to the next revision.
waived_steps._fixture_note: The control. A named accountable party, a ticket, an expiry. A gate that rejects this one is over-strict and will be turned off, which is its own failure mode.
